name: Another Cheat Downloader
description: A MinUI pak for downloading cheat files from the Libretro database.
author: ExpandedPlum

changelog.v0.2.0: Cheat lists now come from a daily index instead of the GitHub API, so every game is available (large systems were cut off at 1,000 files) with no hourly rate limit, and they work offline. Cheats are ranked by how well they match your ROM, and X downloads cheats for every game with a single confident match. Cheats are saved as '<rom file>.cht' so NextUI loads them directly. Supports multi-disc and subfolder games, more file types (.bin, .cdi, .gdi, .cso, .sgx), duplicate-free cheat names, the TrimUI tg5050 platform, download timeouts and HTTPS certificate checks.
changelog.v0.1.3: Fixed crash on launch caused by corrupted cache_system_cheats function and missing find_matching_cheats function. Added error handling for jq processing failures and cleaned up temporary raw API response files.
changelog.v0.1.2: Fixed an issue with status screens not going away.
changelog.v0.1.1: Thanks for the help from the NextUI discord for testing and feedback! Lots of fixes.
